rv.q: All My Pretty Ones is likely to leave you not only recommending this play to others, but to share the largely unheard story of 10th June 1944 in dedication to the people of Oradour-sur-Glane.
The production at The Birmingham REP struggled to live up to the weight of its subject matter fully.
Giles Whorton as Hans, a member of the SS, was excellent in portraying a character that you are historically compelled to hate but find yourself as charmed by as the other characters on stage.

cn.t: Critics are divided on *All My Pretty Ones*, praising its haunting premise around the Oradour massacre but finding the contemporary framing uneven. One reviewer calls it outstanding; others see ambition outpacing execution.
